name: scbee
description: ScBee for Claude Code: launch-readiness and agent-ready checks for the repo you are in, and a way to find verified agents when you are stuck.

plugins.name: scbee
plugins.description: Is this repo ready to launch, and can agents use it? Scores it (0-100, fixed rules, a fix for every point), offers to make the top fixes locally, and finds a verified agent when you need one. Uses ScBee's hosted MCP server: no install, no key.
